chaos_fills.name: Chaos Fills
chaos_fills.summary: Explicit opt-in fills and accents for brief release moments.

moves.name: One-Bar Flash
moves.summary: A short burst concept for future one-shot mutation behavior.
moves.recovery_action: One-Shot Blast must auto-stop and queue Back to Clean
moves.notes: Documentation-only until the one-shot hardware contract is approved.

dark_hypnotic.name: Dark Hypnotic
dark_hypnotic.summary: Low-light tunnel pressure with slow motion and protected kick weight.

moves.name: Shadow Filter Pressure
moves.summary: Lean into dark filter motion while the kick stays stable.
moves.recovery_action: return to Live Safe anchors or Back to Clean
moves.notes: Good first darkening move before heavier pressure.

deep_minimal.name: Deep Minimal
deep_minimal.summary: Sparse, patient, low-risk motion for long-form hypnotic sections.

moves.name: Micro Motion Hold
moves.summary: Small parameter drift that preserves repetition and negative space.
moves.recovery_action: hold current state; no urgent recovery expected
moves.notes: Designed for Evolve Mode later, but passive-only now.

dub_pressure.name: Dub Pressure
dub_pressure.summary: Space, delay pressure, sub weight, and restrained movement.

moves.name: Sub Space Bloom
moves.summary: Widen space and low-end perception without increasing density.
moves.recovery_action: cut delay/reverb sends and return filter to Live Safe
moves.notes: Reference-analyzer future can suggest this from low brightness and high space.

hard_groove.name: Hard Groove
hard_groove.summary: Rolling percussion density with push, swing, and dry machine funk.

moves.name: Rolling Perc Push
moves.summary: Push hats, rims, and supporting percussion around a fixed low end.
moves.recovery_action: mute dense lanes or return percussion pads to journaled baseline
moves.notes: Useful for studio 12-pad work once Pads 5-12 are promoted.

industrial_broken.name: Industrial/Broken
industrial_broken.summary: Broken-grid impact, metallic grit, and unstable machine pressure.

moves.name: Broken Metal Stress
moves.summary: Add metallic bite and broken accents while keeping a recovery cue ready.
moves.recovery_action: skip queued move or fire a transition reset before arming hardware
moves.notes: High-risk live move; safer as a studio exploration until proven.

peak_time.name: Peak Time
peak_time.summary: High-energy warehouse drive with guarded chaos and hard transient focus.

moves.name: Warehouse Lift
moves.summary: Raise movement and transient pressure without freeing the kick.
moves.recovery_action: stage a transition reset or queue Back to Clean
moves.notes: Intended as a visible set-story lift, not an unattended loop.

saved_accidents.name: Saved Accidents
saved_accidents.summary: Favorite accidents worth replaying, varying, or re-crating.

moves.name: Journaled Pressure Rattle
moves.summary: A saved accident pattern promoted into a browsable move.
moves.recovery_action: load the journal seed's Live Safe baseline first
moves.notes: Represents the bridge from journal entry to future crate move.

transitions.name: Transitions
transitions.summary: Moves for leaving, entering, or resetting a section.

moves.name: Back To Clean Handoff
moves.summary: Prepare a clean recovery lane after a high-risk section.
moves.recovery_action: already a recovery move; verify anchors before any SEND
moves.notes: Should remain available near every high-risk queue entry.
